name: HZ_IMP_ADDTNLPARTYNAMES_T
description: The import interface table, HZ_IMP_ADDTNLPARTYNAMES_T, stores information for population into the HZ_ ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES table.

columns.name: ADDTNLPARTYNAME_T_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_IMP_ADDTNLPARTYNAMES_T interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_IMP_ADDTNLPARTYNAMES_T interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System ID for the Party

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the Party

columns.name: ADDTNL_NAME_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System ID for the Additional Party Name

columns.name: ADDTNL_NAME_ORIG_SYSTEM_REF
columns.description: Original System Reference for the Additional Party Name

columns.name: INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a record should be explicitly inserted or updated

columns.name: ACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the action of 'insert' or 'update' based on matching outcome.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party that owns the additional party name

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: The party type can only be Person, Organization, Group or Relationship

columns.name: PARTY_NAME_ID
columns.description: Additional Party Name Id

columns.name: PREFERRED_FLAG
columns.description:
Identify the name as preferred name for this party within this name type.
Possible values are Y and N. Default is N.

columns.name: GLOBAL_PREFERRED_FLAG
columns.description: Identify the name as preferred name for this party across all name types.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME_TYPE
columns.description:
Type of the name. It is a value defined by the Additional Party Name and Identifier Type entity 
The party type should be consistent with the party type that the PARTY_NAME_TYPE can be applied to.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description:
Typically used to store the additional name for the party. 
In the case of Persons it will be used to store the formatted name if necessary for the name type.

columns.name: PERSON_TITLE
columns.description:
A professional or family title. For example, Don or The Right Honorable.
It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used

columns.name: PERSON_ACADEMIC_TITLE
columns.description:
Used to capture the Academic title for a person.
It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used 
Corresponds to the field Degree in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_PRE_NAME_ADJUNCT
columns.description:
Used to capture the name prefix (Mr. Ms, Dr., etc.) for a person.
It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.
Corresponds to the field Prefix in HL7. Validate against lookup CONTACT_TITLE

columns.name: PERSON_FIRST_NAME
columns.description:
Used to capture the first name of a person.
It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used 
Corresponds to the field Given Name in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_MIDDLE_NAME
columns.description:
Used to capture the middle name of a person.
It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used 
Corresponds to the field Middle Initial or Name in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX
columns.description:
Used to capture the Last name prefix (e.g. ?fon?, ?van?, etc.) for a person.
It is used in the same way the new field PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used 
Corresponds to the field Last Name Prefix in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME
columns.description:
Used to capture the last name of a person.
It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used 
Corresponds to the field Family Name in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME
columns.description:
Used to capture the second last name for a person.
In some cultures it is not uncommon to have double last name.
It is used in the same way the new field PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PERSON_PREVIOUS_LAST_NAME
columns.description:
Used to capture the previous last name of a person.
It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used 
It has no mapping in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_SUFFIX
columns.description:
Used to capture the name suffix (e.g. Junior. Sr, the third, etc.) for a person.
It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.
Corresponds to the field Suffix in HL7.

columns.name: TRANSLITERATION_LANG
columns.description:
Used to capture the language used for the name. It is validated against FND_LANGUAGES.LANGUAGE_CODE.
Default value is the Session Language.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Free text comment/description.

columns.description: Status for the data in the interface table

columns.description: Foreign Key to the Error Table
